One Such Plausible Interpretation of ‘Queering Democracy’ / Szomorú vasárnap

2023
Video, 1:48

Made for the BINÁLÉ Digital Art Biennial in Budapest, whose theme was “Queering Democracy,” the video follows a transfeminine character who vandalizes a police car decorated with Viktor Orbán’s image, then drives it off a cliff to “Szomorú vasárnap” (“Gloomy Sunday”), the 1933 Hungarian song known as the suicide song. The biennial pressed for changes, and the work was shown only after a compromise: Orbán’s face was pixelated. The uncensored version appeared in a special exhibition organized by Budapest Pride. The pixelated face leaves the compromise in plain view.
